title: Where did the task time go?
hook: A 30-minute task budget includes repeated urgent admin work in one plan.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to explain the lost task time while keeping the psychological claim separate

misconception: A mathematical time allocation by itself measures the psychological effect of scarcity.
objective: Explain the lost task time while keeping the psychological claim separate.

claims.text: Scarcity argues pressing shortages can capture attention and leave less for other demands.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: No task can overlap admin; no partial task chunks count; zero admin is a counterfactual stipulated schedule, not a treatment result. Exact intervals inputs [{"label": "Admin each chunk", "values": [30, 5, 5]}, {"label": "No urgent admin", "values": [30, 5, 0]}]; second author arithmetic check A=15, B=30. Admin leaves {A} for task chunks; removing it leaves {B}. The consumed time is explicit, not an estimated cognitive penalty.
